question: What is the length of the introductory probationary period for newly hired employees?
ground_truth: Newly hired Class A and Class B employees are subject to a mandatory introductory probationary period of ninety (90) calendar days from their start date.

question: What are the company's designated Core Collaboration Hours?
ground_truth: Core Collaboration Hours are from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST), Monday through Friday.

question: How much is the one-time home office setup allowance for remote employees?
ground_truth: Full-time remote or hybrid employees working at least 2 days remote are eligible for a one-time reimbursement of up to $800 USD.

question: What is the monthly connectivity stipend provided to remote employees?
ground_truth: Qualified remote employees receive a non-taxable monthly internet subsidy of $60 USD disbursed through payroll.

question: How many business days per year can an employee work from an alternate location under Work from Anywhere?
ground_truth: Employees may request to work from an alternate domestic or international location for up to twenty (20) business days per calendar year.

question: How many unused PTO days can be carried forward, and when do they expire?
ground_truth: A maximum of five (5) accrued but unused PTO days may be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year, and must be exhausted by March 31.

question: When is a medical certificate required for sick leave absences?
ground_truth: A medical certificate is mandatory for absences lasting 3 or more consecutive business days, single sick days adjacent to holidays/PTO, or exceeding 6 instances rolling 12-month.

question: How many weeks of paid parental leave are primary caregivers entitled to after 12 months of service?
ground_truth: Primary caregivers who have completed at least twelve (12) months of continuous service are entitled to sixteen (16) weeks of 100% paid parental leave.

question: How many days of paid bereavement leave are provided for the loss of an immediate family member?
ground_truth: Employees receive up to five (5) consecutive paid working days for immediate family members.

question: What is the annual maximum cap for the Tuition Assistance Program?
ground_truth: The Tuition Assistance Program provides up to $5,250 USD per calendar year for pre-approved accredited courses or degrees.

question: What is the minimum grade required for tuition assistance reimbursement?
ground_truth: Reimbursement requires a minimum grade of 'B' (or 'Pass' for pass/fail certifications).

question: Within how many calendar days must travel and business expenses be submitted in Concur?
ground_truth: Expenses must be submitted within thirty (30) calendar days of incurring the expense; expenses after sixty (60) days are rejected.

question: What is the minimum dollar threshold above which an itemized receipt is mandatory for expenses?
ground_truth: An itemized receipt is strictly mandatory for any individual expense item exceeding $25.00 USD.

question: What is the maximum daily per diem meal allowance for business travel?
ground_truth: The cumulative total daily per diem maximum for meals and beverages is $75.00 USD per traveler.

question: What is the maximum allowable value for gifts received from vendors or clients?
ground_truth: Employees may not accept gifts exceeding $50.00 USD, and total gifts from any single entity may not exceed $150.00 USD per year.

question: What is the standard duration of a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)?
ground_truth: The standard PIP duration is thirty (30) calendar days, extendable to sixty (60) days only upon written consent of the HR Director.

question: What is the mandatory notice period for voluntary resignation by Individual Contributors?
ground_truth: Individual Contributors (Levels 1 to 3) must provide a mandatory minimum notice period of two (2) calendar weeks (14 days).

question: What is the maximum severance pay cap in the event of involuntary redundancy?
ground_truth: Total severance entitlement shall not exceed a maximum ceiling of sixteen (16) weeks' base pay.

question: Within how many hours must all company hardware and property be returned following termination?
ground_truth: All assigned laptops, monitors, cards, badges, and documentation must be returned within forty-eight (48) hours of termination.

question: Within how many hours must a workplace injury be reported?
ground_truth: Any workplace injury must be reported to the manager and Safety Coordinator within twenty-four (24) hours of occurrence.

question: Can an employee on probation work remotely or take discretionary annual leave?
ground_truth: No. Under Section 1.3 and Section 2.2, remote work privileges remain restricted during the 90-day probationary period, and discretionary annual leave cannot be taken during probation except when pre-approved in writing at offer stage.

question: If an employee resigns 18 months after receiving tuition reimbursement, how much must they repay and how does the company recover it?
ground_truth: Under Section 4.4 and Section 9.4, because resignation occurred between 13 and 24 months, the employee must repay 50% of the tuition funds received, which may be offset against final salary payments.

question: What are the remote work restrictions and office attendance requirements for an employee placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)?
ground_truth: Under Section 2.2 and Section 8.2, employees placed on a PIP have remote work privileges suspended and must attend the office five days a week until successful PIP completion.

question: When an employee is laid off in an involuntary reduction in force (RIF), how is their 401(k) vesting and severance calculated?
ground_truth: Under Section 4.2 and Section 9.3, all employer matching funds vest immediately at 100% as an exception, and severance is one week of base salary per completed year of service (minimum 2 weeks, maximum 16 weeks cap) plus 3 months COBRA subsidy.

question: What notice period applies to a probationary employee resigning, and when must they return company property?
ground_truth: Under Section 9.1 and Section 9.4, probationary employees must give 1 calendar week (7 days) notice, and all company equipment must be returned within 48 hours of termination.
